description: Returns the current price, currency, whether it is in stock, and the stock count when the store gives one, for one or more products found in a product search, taking their ids from the search results. Store catalogs are kept constantly refreshed, so the price and stock are up to date. There is no price history, as the catalogs keep none. For follow-up calls in this conversation, send the visitorId returned by a previous result unchanged. Omit it on the first call; do not invent one.
